items.statement: Generated SDK files require reading CONTRIBUTING.md first; handwritten surfaces stay small and exported APIs change only when the task requires it.
requires-python is the technical minimum and PYTHON_VERSION_POLICY.md is the human-readable policy.
Support every fully released non-EOL CPython line, with only a documented grace period for the most recently retired line.
All listed repository and CI Python-version surfaces must stay synchronized.
A minimum-Python change must not be combined with unrelated SDK or dependency upgrades.
A floor change updates all named policy, lock, documentation, compatibility, CI, build, metadata, and old-interpreter checks.
The pull request adds the specified release-note section without promising old-release security backports.
An SDK CODEOWNER must approve the floor change.
The deterministic policy check proves consistency only; it cannot decide the grace-period or floor policy.
The normal CI workflow and its scheduled modes retain their distinct trigger and coverage responsibilities.
The monthly review consumes both official CPython lifecycle and public PyPI minor-version data.
The review Codex runtime is pinned, unprivileged, has no command network access, and has read-only repository permissions.
Codex cannot edit or call GitHub; a separate credential-free job may open or refresh one issue only when needed, and automation never changes the floor or merges.
All ten named local validation commands run before publishing a Python-version change.
The scheduled compatibility matrix also runs before release.
